marketing.heroEyebrow: Open source · PRISMA 2020 · AI you verify
marketing.heroTitle: The systematic review workbench that keeps you in control
marketing.heroText: Import your searches, remove duplicates, screen with your team, extract data with an AI that quotes its sources, and report with the official PRISMA flow. Free to self-host, ready to use online.
marketing.trust: Built by researchers, for research teams in Africa and Europe. AGPL-3.0 licensed.
marketing.stepsTitle: From search export to PRISMA diagram

import.title: Import
import.text: RIS, BibTeX, PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus CSV, Excel. Format detected automatically, every file kept as a batch.

dedup.title: Deduplicate
dedup.text: DOI and title matches merge on their own. Near matches wait for your call, with the evidence side by side.

screen.title: Screen
screen.text: Title and abstract, then full text. Blind double screening, conflicts, keyboard shortcuts, highlighted keywords.

extract.title: Extract
extract.text: You design the form. The AI fills it from each PDF with a verbatim quote per field. You verify, next to the paper.

report.title: Report
report.text: PRISMA 2020 counts and diagram, exactly as the official template, plus RIS, CSV and Excel exports.

marketing.aiText: Suggestions are stored apart from decisions and always need a human click. Bring your own API key, or use the credits included in paid plans.
marketing.teamText: Invite reviewers by email, choose single or double screening, hide decisions in blind mode, resolve conflicts, follow each reviewer's progress and time.
marketing.openText: The whole application is AGPL-3.0; the parsing and deduplication engine is MIT. Run it on your laptop, your lab server or our hosted service.
marketing.stepsLede: Five stages, one workspace, and nothing you cannot export.

pricingTeaser.title: Self-host for free, forever.
pricingTeaser.text: The hosted Free plan is open today. Pro and Institution plans open once billing and the legal documents are ready.

marketing.closingTitle: Free to try, free to leave.
marketing.closingText: Everything you build in Tamis exports as RIS, CSV, Excel and a PRISMA 2020 diagram. The code is AGPL-3.0: if we ever stop, you can host it yourself.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lede: A real person reads every message, in English or French. Bugs and feature requests move fastest through GitHub; institutional questions, free-access requests and anything private go by e-mail.

institutions.title: Institutions
institutions.text: Single sign-on, admin console, invoicing and a data processing agreement for universities and organisations. Tell us the number of reviewers, the review types and your data requirements.

lowIncome.title: Free Pro access
lowIncome.text: Reviewers at institutions in low-income countries get the Pro plan for free. Write from your institutional e-mail address with your name and department.

support.title: Support and bugs
support.text: The issue tracker is public: search it first, then open an issue with what you did, what you expected and what happened. Questions and ideas go to Discussions.

contact.emailSoon: A private e-mail address will be published here once our domain is set up. Until then, use GitHub or reply to the e-mail you received from us.
contact.response: We answer within five working days; there is no phone line or live chat.
